name: manual_886258
claim: git diff --cached is the right pre-commit default and is empty on a CI checkout. CI must pass an explicit three-dot base and head. For pull requests use the pull-request head SHA, not the synthetic merge commit.

decisions.notes: CodeRabbit review 5324280369 comment 4109939031 on orama-system PR 366. Empty CI index hid committed prohibited-address literals. Fixed in Perpetua-Tools a8292083d3e0fd18985efbd551da56bde5cd9c18 and orama-system 121aeea1ecd970d6ff15f26fb1added8a6d2c954. One-sided base or head is an error. Refs must be non-empty and must not start with a dash.
